elements.name: Kick / transfer stage (wet)
elements.notes: Dry ~80–100 kg + propellant ~250–280 kg; storable hypergolic

elements.name: Entry probe + balloon + gondola (dry stack)
elements.notes: Aggregate of heatshield + balloon + gondola + avionics (must bound detailed lines)

elements.name: Gondola + sensor suite
elements.notes: Flush black bay. Science ~8 kg (sensor-suite.json); structure/thermal/UHF/harness fill the rest.

elements.name: Avionics, power, structure, comms
elements.notes: C&DH, PDU, 400 Wh-class battery, polar-patch electronics. UHF on the bay.

contingency: Positive headroom vs 400 kg wet — acid protection, helium, redundancy. CubeSat is a second vehicle.
